'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 Stephen Kim DS Coruscant''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Stephen Kim]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Coruscant (Dark) (Special Edition)|SE-D-coruscant.gif|label=Coruscant}}
* '''Deck name:''' Something Something Dark Side
* '''Username:''' raith
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.3]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
